set -eu; EXPECTED=deda0a88cff78d9a9156e54893546d0e4304dadb; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; PORT=18115; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE" = 0; echo identity_positive_call_state=$CALL_STATE; adb -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:$PORT >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:$PORT tcp:$PORT >/dev/null; curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/props > /tmp/identity-positive-props.json; python3 -c "import json; p=json.load(open('/tmp/identity-positive-props.json')); assert p.get('model_alias') == 'qwen-phone-1.5b', p; assert p.get('model_path') == '/data/local/tmp/aicall-phone-llm/model-1.5b.gguf', p; print('identity_positive_props_verified=true')"; "$GRADLE_BIN" :app:assembleDebug >/tmp/identity-positive-build.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/identity-positive-build.log; exit 1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/identity-positive-install.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/identity-positive-install.log; exit 1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f files/local-phone-llm-speech-pipeline-report.txt 2>/dev/null || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.DiagnosticProbeActivity" --ez run_local_phone_llm_speech_pipeline_probe true >/tmp/identity-positive-start.log; REPORT=''; for _ in $(seq 1 300); do REPORT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" cat files/local-phone-llm-speech-pipeline-report.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$' && break; sleep 0.5; done; echo '--- identity positive report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT"; echo '--- end identity positive report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^backend_config_valid=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^stt_transcript_nonblank=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^backend_complete_response=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^approved_output_pcm_nonempty=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^local_phone_llm_speech_pipeline_success=true$'; HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG:call_media" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); test -z "$HELPER"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo local_phone_identity_positive_proven_s22=true
